evidence:
Walked instruction.md and /instructions/hireops_rules.md + integration.md line by line against the frozen solution/app (hashes match manifest; all 8 raw-evidence-index artifacts re-hashed OK and all 12 matching_source_files match the frozen bytes). Every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation:
- Runtime: server.js -> src/index.js; bootstrap.js:16-20 answers /api/health on the main thread before any DB work; PORT honoured (bootstrap.js:43); db.js:10 uses DB_PATH else path.join(__dirname,'..','app.db') = /app/app.db; seed read beside the module (db.js:11) and loaded once only when users is empty (db.js:62-63); solution seed byte-identical to /assets seed; static files served relative to __dirname (index.js:42-43); only express, better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins.
- Sign-in/roles: login/logout/me with server session cookie only (index.js:84-101); 401/403 via auth() (73-81); candidate gets 404 for others' applications (application():127, mayMove:330, staffOnly:382).
- Jobs/candidates: POST /api/jobs recruiter-only, manager chosen from hiring-manager accounts, limit 1..50 (202-214); add candidate with email check, case-insensitive duplicate per job, field-level error {field:'candidate_email'}, link to candidate account, bottom of Applied (216-233); UI forms keep typed values and mark the email field (board.js:47-56, 69-81).
- Board: six stages, one-step forward/back, reject needs a reason, Hired not rejectable, reopen only to rejected_from and clears reason (checkMove 238-265; update 312-314); Up/Down reorder and before_id drop placement (board.js:233-241, 300-319; index.js:297-307); Interview cap with in-stage reorder exempt (290-295); hiring-manager limits: own job, Interview/Offer/Hired, reject/reopen from those (257-264); observer/candidate refused (mayMove).
- Concurrency: per-card version; stale 409 message names who via the card's last activity line (241-245); optimistic move, revert to snapshot, show reason, refocus card controls, refresh (board.js:181-205).
- Bulk: 2-50 cards of one job, board-order sort, all-or-nothing transaction, Interview places counted for the set (index.js:274-321, 339-344; UI bulk bar board.js:277-290).
- Undo: own latest action only, single-use, refused on any version change or Interview overfill, restores stage/place/reason, logs a line (348-373; myUndo 165-168; UI board.js:291-299, 367-368).
- Notes: detail panel with notes, role-gated writing, observer read-only, unsaved note kept per user in localStorage (board.js:85-141; index.js:386-398).
- Activity: lines for job open, add, move, reject (with reason), reopen, reorder, undo; refused actions roll back in the transaction so leave no line; view newest first with All jobs / one-job filter (index.js:195-198, 189; app.js:45-85).
- Live updates: SSE 'changed' after every successful write including read marks (index.js:45-54, 102-107; app.js:138-172); views are patched in place so open card, drafts, focus and scroll are preserved (board.js renderBoard 321-341; threads.js update 204-215).
- Conversations: role access (threadAccess 114-120); latest 30, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count, scroll anchored (index.js:401-417; threads.js:161-176, paint 85-87); Enter sends / Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and focused after send, failure keeps text with an error (threads.js:184-202); line breaks via white-space:pre-wrap (styles.css:105); arrivals while scrolled up keep place, show 'N new messages' and stay unread (threads.js:146-160); per-person unread, own messages never unread, sending marks read (index.js:132-139, 423-427); seen on latest own message with observer excluded (143-150; threads.js:76-83); per-user per-conversation drafts persisted across switch, reload and session loss (app.js:39-43, 195-203; threads.js:113, 125, 183); nav total badge (app.js:120-129).
- Candidate view: own applications only with job title, team, candidate wording and unread count; conversation opens only when chosen (index.js:171-176; threads.js:7, 30, 49-56); candidate payloads carry no notes, reason, rejected_from, position, other candidates or activity.
- Staff Board / Conversations / Activity views and candidate 'My applications' view (app.js:87-91).
Supporting runtime evidence (scripted golden only, not a configured judge run): qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json (sha256 7df855f4...) records 26 scripted golden groups, all passed, page_errors [], against the frozen bytes, including restart, live board arrival (800 ms), paging, drafts across session loss, candidate privacy and observer read-only.
